sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for page animation
sections.what: Brings in the animation tools and the current page path reader.
sections.why: The animation needs a library for motion and a way to tell when the page changes.

sections.name: PageTransition
sections.title: Fade and slide between pages
sections.what: Wraps page content so that when the address changes, the old page fades and slides out and the new one fades and slides in with a spring feel. The change is keyed to the address.
sections.why: Makes moving between pages feel smooth. Reason for the wait mode is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Because the key is the address, every new address triggers the animation, including small changes such as filters in the address. Wait mode means the new page appears only after the old one leaves, which can add a short delay.

summary: Fades and slides each page in and out when the user moves between pages.
why: Header says smooth route segment transitions. Likely reason: visual polish. The choice of spring settings is not explained.
how: Watches the current address. Wraps the page content in an animated box keyed by the address, so a change of address runs the exit animation and then the enter animation, one at a time.
inputs: The current address, and the page content passed in as children.
outputs: The page content, wrapped in an animation.
risks: Because the key is the address, each new address remounts the page content. The new page waits for the exit animation to finish, so a slow exit delays it.
debug: If pages lag or flicker, check the exit animation settings. If pages do not animate, check that the page content is wrapped by this component.
